paragraphs: ROLLER sells venue management software to attractions businesses, pulling bookings, point of sale, memberships and reporting into a single platform. It is cloud-based and built for growing attractions businesses, meant to stand in for the several tools a venue would otherwise run. The company describes the platform as powering more than 3,000 attractions.

Ticketing is built around flexible bookings and add-on sales for both staff and guests. Operators running more than one site can hold branding consistent across locations and publish changes from a single headquarters account. Plans are tiered, with an entry level covering online and in-venue selling and day-to-day operations. Higher tiers are aimed at established venues wanting more customization and support.

One franchise operator, We Rock the Spectrum, put the platform into more than 120 locations over six months. Another customer, Area 51, is described on the site as an Australian family entertainment center operator running venues across multiple states. The company also publishes a guest survey it says covers 1,500 people.

quote.text: Purpose-built for growing attractions businesses, ROLLER is a cloud-based solution that replaces multiple tools needed to operate effectively and deliver better guest experiences.
